criteria.requirement: Add funcy.pipeline Stage, Pipeline and PipelineResult using real Funcy make_func selectors. Validate unique nonempty names, callable optional input/output adapters and explicit raise/report policy. Run stages once in order with unary function protocol; an empty pipeline is identity, optional run(report=True) returns final value plus stage-only events without retaining inputs/intermediate business values. Default PipelineStageError carries name/index/input-function-output phase and original __cause__; report policy returns fixed failure result and stops later stages, omitting value-bearing exception text. Reject async stages/awaitable results explicitly, preserve original compose/rcompose and no implicit retry.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
